t: A low-cost Arm chip on the FRDM-KL25Z teaching board from NXP.
steps: Buy the FRDM-KL25Z board from NXP for about 19 US dollars.
Get a USB cable to match the board, as the kit ships without one.
Install the free Zephyr tools on your computer by following the Zephyr getting started guide.
Update the board's debug firmware to DAPLink. Older boards may need a bootloader update first.
Build the Zephyr blinky example for the frdm_kl25z board.
Flash it and watch the color light blink.
Try the touch slider or analog input samples next.
meta: Open Code. From $19.25. A few stores.
